sn35.29:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn35.29:1.3: There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn35.29:1.5: And what, bhikkhus, is the all that is weighed down?
sn35.29:1.6: The eye is weighed down, forms are weighed down, eye-consciousness is weighed down, eye-contact is weighed down, and whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition— whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant—that too is weighed down.
sn35.29:1.8: Weighed down by birth, aging, and death; by sorrow, lamentation, pain, displeasure, and despair, I say. “The ear is weighed down … The mind is weighed down …
sn35.29:1.15: Weighed down by birth … by despair, I say. “Seeing thus … He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’ ”
